verdict.rationale: Decagon's Suggestions product says it automatically detects knowledge gaps and drafts help-center content based on how human agents resolved those issues. Duet also says it iterates on the agent as conversations reveal gaps. Nothing in the pack shows detection of conflicting or contradictory knowledge content, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: detection of conflicting or contradictory content, linkage of gaps to specific missed or fumbled agent answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the platform surfaces knowledge gaps and conflicting content that cause the agent to miss or fumble questions

citations.quote: It automatically detects knowledge gaps and generates content drafts based on how your best human agents resolved those same issues, so your help center stays ahead of customer needs.
As conversations reveal gaps and new opportunities, Duet automatically iterates on your agent, from the first launch through every improvement after.
